script: The Clippers are doomed, cuz he just got even more catastrophic for the Clippers. It's not only the worst trade in NBA history, because it led to the Clippers losing Kawhi for catastrophic behavior. The NBA officially ruled that yes, the Clippers did circumvent the salary cap by helping Kawhi receive outside compensation from companies that did business with the team. The Clippers were fined $30 million. Steve Ballmer was suspended for one year. Executives suspended and the team had to forfeit 5 first-round draft picks from 2029 to 2033. Kawhi, though, he was only fined $700,000, the biggest win for him is no suspension. His contract was not voided, and that means his trade to the Raptors can now move forward. Toronto is expected to get Kawhi, and the Clippers receive Brandon Ingram, Grady Dick, and several first-round draft picks. But it is entirely possible, though being improbable, that the Clippers can undo their end of the deal and dump Kawhi for some more picks, since they just lost five of them. The George era was way worse than the Siakam and Leonard era. Paul George was basically cursed for a decade, and we can only blame the greed of billionaires trying to dodge the salary cap.
what_makes_it_work: Humorous animated caricatures of NBA players and executives make the analysis entertaining.
Fast pacing and frequent visual shifts maintain viewer attention throughout.
A blend of satirical animation and actual footage grounds the comedic premise in real sports news.
